item.title: CVE-2026-125086 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 9.3
item.description: Tuesday 10 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 9.3 | A vulnerability has been found in D-Link M60 1.12.B01. Impacted is the function system of the file /etc/emDaemon/mosquitto.conf of the component emDaemon MQTT Broker. Such manipulation leads to hard-coded credentials. The attack can be executed remotely. The exploit has been disclosed to the public and may be used.

item.title: CVE-2026-125087 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 5.5
item.description: Tuesday 10 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 5.5 | A vulnerability was found in Michael-A-Kuykendall Shimmy up to 2.6.4. The affected element is an unknown function of the file src/server.rs of the component Inference API. Performing a manipulation results in missing authentication. The attack is possible to be carried out remotely. Upgrading to version 2.6.5 is sufficient to fix this issue. The patch is named 3f2ee748c02eeb229987913fe289a2ed9a24595d. You should upgrade the affected component.

item.title: CVE-2026-76964 - NVD - CVSS Score v3.1: 10.0
item.description: Tuesday 10 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v3.1: 10.0 | SAP NetWeaver Application Server ABAP does not sufficiently validate certain network input processed by an internal component. An unauthenticated attacker could send specially crafted network traffic to trigger a memory corruption condition in the affected functionality. Successful exploitation could allow the attacker to execute arbitrary code and fully compromise the system, resulting in a high impact on confidentiality, integrity and availability of the system.

item.title: CVE-2026-76965 - NVD - CVSS Score v3.1: 9.9
item.description: Tuesday 10 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v3.1: 9.9 | SAP NetWeaver Application Server ABAP and ABAP Platform does not perform necessary authorization checks for certain internal functionality. Successful exploitation could impact resources beyond the vulnerable component, resulting in a high impact on confidentiality, integrity and availability of the system.

item.title: CVE-2026-76966 - NVD - CVSS Score v3.1: 8.9
item.description: Tuesday 10 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v3.1: 8.9 | Due to improper RFC protocol validation in the SAP Kernel used by the Application Server ABAP of SAP NetWeaver and ABAP Platform, an unauthenticated attacker can send a crafted RFC request that exploits logical errors in memory management, leading to memory corruption. This could lead to a high impact on confidentiality and integrity with low impact on availability of the application.

item.title: CVE-2026-76970 - NVD - CVSS Score v3.1: 7.5
item.description: Tuesday 10 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v3.1: 7.5 | Due to a Memory Corruption vulnerability in Application Server ABAP for SAP NetWeaver and ABAP Platform, an unauthenticated attacker could send specially crafted requests to the application. If processed by the application, these requests could trigger a memory corruption condition in the parsing routine, which could cause the affected processes to crash and restart. By repeatedly sending such requests, the attacker could cause a sustained denial of service, leading to a high impact on availability. Confidentiality and integrity remain unaffected.

item.title: CVE-2026-76973 - NVD - CVSS Score v3.1: 7.5
item.description: Tuesday 10 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v3.1: 7.5 | Due to a Memory Corruption vulnerability in Application Server ABAP of SAP NetWeaver and ABAP Platform, an unauthenticated attacker could send specially crafted network requests to the affected service. By triggering the vulnerability, the attacker could cause the server to crash and disrupt active connections, leading to a denial of service condition. Successful exploitation could result in a high impact to the availability while the confidentiality and integrity remains unaffected.

item.title: CVE-2026-89103 - NVD - CVSS Score v3.1: 10.0

item.title: CVE-2026-89115 - NVD - CVSS Score v3.1: 4.4

item.title: CVE-2026-89119 - NVD - CVSS Score v3.1: 9.6
item.description: Tuesday 10 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v3.1: 9.6 | SAP Web Dispatcher and SAP NetWeaver Application Server ABAP (Internet Communication Manager) do not perform sufficient request validation in certain administrative functionality. Successful exploitation could lead to a full compromise of the underlying operating system, resulting in a high impact on confidentiality, integrity, and availability.

item.title: CVE-2026-115640 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 7.4
item.description: Tuesday 10 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 7.4 | LimeSurvey Community Edition 7.7.0 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability in the Central Participants Database blocklist control. An authenticated user with only global participantpanel:import permission can import a CSV participant_id containing HTML. The import flow persists that value without model validation. When a CPDB editor opens the participant list, LimeSurvey derives ButtonGroupWidget id and name attributes from participant_id and inserts them without HTML encoding, causing attacker-controlled markup to execute in the victim's authenticated LimeSurvey origin. Exploitation can access session-exposed data and issue same-origin requests with the victim's effective permissions.

item.title: CVE-2026-96769 - NVD - CVSS Score v3.1: 5.3
item.description: Tuesday 10 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v3.1: 5.3 | The Extend B2B - Companies and Users Management for WooCommerce plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Sensitive Information Exposure in all versions up to, and including, 2.1.4 via the register_company_api. This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers to extract sensitive company data including owner and member WordPress user IDs, company billing email addresses, credit balances and full credit histories with admin user IDs, per-member purchase limits and spend totals, and shared-cart records containing purchase-order numbers.
